nativeValidation.setup: Use a non-elevated PowerShell session on delino-win-1 in a clean checkout at the stated revision. Use a filesystem with Windows DACL support and Go 1.26.1 or the repository toolchain. After creating the scratch directory, copy the loopback probe to copyTo. Run the commands from the repository root and retain the logs. The tests use synthetic credentials.
commands: if ((git rev-parse HEAD) -ne 'ba41ad9c56298bc0e0ad21c71168155fabfaa6b3') { throw 'Wrong validation revision' }; if ((go env GOOS) -ne 'windows') { throw 'Go must target Windows' }

go test -json -count=1 ./cmds/internal/credstore -run '^TestWindowsCredentialReadSerializesReplacement$' | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/credstore/windows-replacement.jsonl'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Isolated credential replacement test failed' }
go test -json -count=1 ./cmds/internal/credstore | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/credstore/windows-credstore.jsonl'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'Credential store tests failed' }

go test -json -count=1 ./cmds/ownsand/internal/cli ./cmds/sandrun/internal/cli -run 'Login|Logout|Refresh|TokenSource' | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/credstore/windows-cli-auth.jsonl'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CLI authentication tests failed' }
go build -trimpath -o '.t3-tmp/credstore/bin/' ./cmds/ownsand ./cmds/sandrun; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CLI builds failed' }
go run '.t3-tmp/credstore/cli-probe.go' '.t3-tmp/credstore/bin' | Tee-Object -FilePath '.t3-tmp/credstore/windows-cli-loopback.log'; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { throw 'CLI loopback probe failed' }
expectedResults: The isolated replacement test holds an open credential file for 2.25 seconds. The concurrent refresh waits, publishes the rotation, and leaves complete old and new documents observable. Both protected DACLs grant access only to the current user. The directory can contain multiple entries for that user. The test fails on any grant to another principal or if there is no direct grant.
TestWindowsLoadWaitsForStoreLock shows the production Load waits while the store lock is held. The cross-process lock, external sharing retry, missing credentials and logout tests pass.
CLI authorization tests pass, including logout during refresh, login during refresh, and discarding a result from an older refresh generation.
The loopback probe prints a passing line for ownsand and one for sandrun. Each binary completes login, rotation, an authenticated request, logout and a signed-out request.
